thread:
Jules: Kicking off canary for feature healthlights v1.2.0 — 5% traffic to canary workers in us-west-2, started 09:00 PT. Will be watching latency, p50/p95, and 5xx. Deploy id: deploy-1768754321.
Priya: 👍 Dashboards up. Alert rules adjusted: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 10m -> notify oncall + trigger rollback. I also muted a noisy downstream API error so it doesn't pollute alerts.
Anita: QA ran smoke tests on canary last night, all green except one minor UI flicker on banner dismiss. Not blocking rollout but logging a ticket.
Marco: Oncall here. I'll tail api and ingress logs for the first 30m, SMS if anything spikes. Runbook link: https://redwood/cookbooks/canary-rollback (copied).
deploy-bot: deploy-1768754321: healthlights v1.2.0 canary started at 2026-03-17T16:00:00Z targeting 5% traffic in us-west-2.
Jules: Quick perf note — initial tokenization latency up ~8% on canary; could be sampling noise. Priya can you confirm kernel/quantization variant?
Priya: Confirmed we used quantized q4m variant on canary since it's default for this model. I'll spin a parallel canary with q8_0 to compare if issues persist.
Anita: FYI I saw one user reported incorrect banner state in canary session. Captured reproduction steps in ticket HL-321. Not widespread.
Marco: Got a spike at +1% 5xx at 09:12 PT for ~3m, traced to a downstream timeout. It recovered after circuit opened. No rollback.
Jules: Thanks. Can we add a short-lived metric to track "banner-dismiss-fail"? If rate increases we pause.
Priya: Added metric and dashboard tile. Also added a temporary featureflag fallback: flag healthlights.use_legacy_dismiss = true if errors > threshold.
Anita: I pushed a fix branch for the UI flicker — PR #4826. Would appreciate a quick review from @Jules before we promote to canary variant.
Jules: Reviewing now, will comment on small styling nit.
Marco: No further alerts. Latency stable. Recommendation: increase to 20% at +45m if no regressions.
deploy-bot: deploy-1768754321: canary health check at +30m: ok. p50 +6% vs baseline, p95 +2% (within SLO). 5xx 0.12%.
Jules: Good to move to 20% in 30m unless anyone objects.
Anita: No objections from QA side. PR merged.
Priya: I'll prepare a 20% rollout with the q8_0 variant as a quick A/B to validate latency delta.
Marco: Proceeding to schedule 20% shift at 09:45 PT. Oncall will stay watching for next 2 hours.
Jules: Thanks team. If anything pops, use this thread and ping @Marco for immediate action. Otherwise I'll open a post-rollout note after 3 hours.
